newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: GOLF-SOUTH AFRICA'S PGA CHIEF RESIGNS.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-SOUTH AFRICA'S PGA CHIEF RESIGNS.

text.p: Brent Chalmers, commissioner of South Africa's PGA Tour, announced his resignation on Monday.
He will leave on December 1 after a five-year tenure.
"I originally planned to stay for only three years and somehow I'm now delivering my fifth FNB Tour," Chalmers said.
The value of the Tour has grown from 3.5 million rand ($750,000) to 14 million rand ($2.98 million) a season since Chalmers took charge.
